lines.en: label chikadorm45:
I knock on Chika’s door, convince her to move out of her shitty apartment for the sake of her sister, and we all live happily ever after.
lines.zh: 我敲开 Chika 的门，劝她为了妹妹搬出那间破公寓，然后我们从此幸福地生活在一起。

lines.en: The end.
lines.zh: 剧终。

lines.en: No. Obviously that’s not how today is going to play out because, even after spending an entire night going over all of the questions Tsubasa asked me, I still haven’t really figured out how I feel.
lines.zh: 才怪。今天显然不会这么发展，因为就算我把 Tsubasa 问我的那些问题翻来覆去想了一整夜，我还是没弄清自己到底什么感受。

lines.en: And that {i}includes{/i} not fully understanding why I’m so hesitant about this either.
lines.zh: 这也{i}包括{/i}，我没完全搞懂自己为什么对这事这么犹豫。

lines.en: On paper, there’s not really a good reason {i}for{/i} me to feel so strange about this.
lines.zh: 纸面上看，我没什么正当理由{i}对{/i}这事感到这么别扭。

lines.en: Having Chika live in a better neighborhood wouldn’t just be safer for her and Chinami, but it would make getting to them a million times easier.
lines.zh: 让 Chika 住到好一点的地段，不光对她和 Chinami 更安全，也能让我去找她们方便一百万倍。

lines.en: It would also likely increase the amount of times we’re able to have sex per month as a result of this- and that is a statistic I’d be damned if I overlooked.
lines.zh: 而且这么一来，我们每个月能做爱的次数多半也会增加——这个数据我可绝不会忽略。

lines.en: And yet...something about it feels wrong.
lines.zh: 可……总觉得哪里不对劲。

lines.en: : Come in!
lines.zh: : 进来吧！

lines.en: scene black
Call it sympathy or empathy or whatever other pathy is the one that makes you start feeling all gross inside, but the truth is it’s a lot more complicated than that.
lines.zh: 管它叫同情、共情还是别的什么「情」，就是那种让你心里发毛的感觉——但真相要复杂得多。

lines.en: I just can’t help but feel like having her so close by won’t end well.
lines.zh: 我就是忍不住觉得，让她住得离我这么近，不会有好结果。

lines.en: At the very least, it would make me a lot more hesitant before organizing any slumber parties again.
lines.zh: 至少，这会让我以后再也不敢随便组织什么睡衣派对。

lines.en: scene chikatres1
: Hey!
It’s fine. It’s not like I’m in any rush.

lines.en: I don’t want things to {i}have{/i} to come to that, but...if it’s the easiest option-

lines.en: No.
lines.zh: 不。

lines.zh: 我不想去想那个。

lines.en: : Hey. My bad. Inner monologue is now complete.

lines.en: : Was it about how casually seductive I look right now and how much you want to fuck my brains out?

She stays silent for a moment once the two of us take our places on the bed.

lines.zh: 她说得对，我们很多最重要的谈话都是在这儿发生的……其实刚在一起那会儿，几乎{i}所有事{/i}都发生在这儿。

lines.en: But, as life marches onward, I find myself spending less and less time atop this mattress and more time everywhere else.
lines.zh: 可随着日子往前过，我发现自己待在这张床垫上的时间越来越少，待在别处的时间越来越多。

lines.en: What was once so familiar to me is now a bittersweet touch of nostalgia...
lines.zh: 曾经那么熟悉的地方，如今成了一种苦乐参半的怀旧……

lines.en: And all I can hope is that the sweetness isn’t ruined by something that might be hard for me to hear.

lines.en: : Sure, there are moments when that’s hard. And I really wish I could share my happiness with other people, but...I totally understand why I {i}can’t{/i} since it puts you at risk.
